meetings.Meeting Title: Sprint Planning for Enterprise AI Workspace
meetings.Participants: Rohan Sharma; Ananya Iyer; Vikram Rao; Arjun Patel; Karthik Reddy
meetings.Agenda: Finalize sprint scope and assign ownership for authentication, dashboards, and RAG discovery.
meetings.Decisions: Sprint 1 will prioritize login, employee dashboard shell, authentication API, and RAG proof of concept.
meetings.Action Items: Rohan to prepare vector store plan; Vikram to publish auth API contract; Arjun to start login page.

meetings.Participants: Rohan Sharma; Ananya Iyer; Vikram Rao; Meera Krishnan
meetings.Agenda: Review AI assistant service boundary, document retrieval, security, and latency targets.
meetings.Decisions: Adopt FastAPI service for assistant orchestration and keep document access filtered by role metadata.
meetings.Action Items: Ananya to define evaluation set; Meera to add API logging; Rohan to configure ChromaDB collections.

meetings.Participants: Arjun Patel; Sneha Kulkarni; Vikram Rao; Divya Singh
meetings.Agenda: Check employee and manager dashboard progress, data contracts, and blocker list.
meetings.Decisions: Manager dashboard will expose completion rate, overdue tasks, and department performance from the same task table.
meetings.Action Items: Sneha to finish metric cards; Vikram to add task summary endpoint; Divya to validate label wording.

meetings.Participants: Karthik Reddy; Nisha Gupta; Meera Krishnan; Arjun Patel
meetings.Agenda: Define QA approach for authentication, dashboards, document retrieval, and regression cycles.
meetings.Decisions: Cypress will cover core UI workflows and Postman collections will validate API contracts.
meetings.Action Items: Karthik to draft test plan; Nisha to create regression checklist; Meera to share test credentials.

meetings.Participants: Farhan Khan; Divya Singh; Rohan Sharma; Ananya Iyer
meetings.Agenda: Prepare HR and company policy documents for RAG ingestion and employee self-service.
meetings.Decisions: Policies will be chunked by section and tagged by policy type, effective date, and audience.
meetings.Action Items: Farhan to finalize leave policy; Divya to standardize document headers; Ananya to test retrieval quality.

meetings.Meeting Title: Client Feedback Review for Project Alpha
meetings.Participants: Rohan Sharma; Ananya Iyer; Arjun Patel; Sneha Kulkarni; Karthik Reddy
meetings.Agenda: Discuss client feedback on dashboard navigation, assistant response tone, and export requirements.
meetings.Decisions: Team will add clearer status filters, export-ready dashboard data, and concise assistant citations.
meetings.Action Items: Sneha to update filter design; Rohan to tune assistant prompt; Karthik to add acceptance scenarios.

meetings.Participants: Rohan Sharma; Ananya Iyer; Vikram Rao; Nisha Gupta
meetings.Agenda: Validate ingestion pipeline, embedding metadata, retrieval relevance, and fallback behavior.
meetings.Decisions: Use document version metadata to prefer latest approved files while preserving older versions for audit.
meetings.Action Items: Ananya to add version-aware retrieval tests; Vikram to expose document list endpoint; Nisha to run query set.

meetings.Participants: Vikram Rao; Meera Krishnan; Karthik Reddy; Divya Singh
meetings.Agenda: Review Docker setup, environment variables, rollback plan, and release documentation.
meetings.Decisions: Release candidate will deploy to staging after security policy review and QA sign-off.
meetings.Action Items: Meera to update compose file; Karthik to publish sign-off report; Divya to prepare release checklist.

meetings.Participants: Farhan Khan; Divya Singh; Karthik Reddy; Nisha Gupta; Sneha Kulkarni
meetings.Agenda: Review employee workload balance, pending tasks, and support needs.
meetings.Decisions: Tasks are evenly distributed, but QA requires two focused regression windows before final demo.
meetings.Action Items: Farhan to update workload tracker; Nisha to flag high-risk test cases; Sneha to close dashboard UI issues.

meetings.Participants: Rohan Sharma; Ananya Iyer; Vikram Rao; Arjun Patel; Sneha Kulkarni; Karthik Reddy; Farhan Khan
meetings.Agenda: Prepare final year project demo flow, data story, known limitations, and presentation sequence.
meetings.Decisions: Demo will show login, dashboards, task workflow, document search, AI assistant, and SQL-backed analytics.
meetings.Action Items: Rohan to prepare AI demo prompts; Arjun to verify UI flows; Karthik to perform final smoke test.
